gaps.sentence: The results of the survey were highly ___ (SURPRISE).

gaps.explanation: 'Highly suspicious' — the adjective for something that looks wrong.

gaps.sentence: He is one of the most ___ (SUCCESS) businessmen in the region.
The palace is open to ___ (VISIT) all year.

gaps.explanation: 'Trustworthy' = deserving trust; 'trusted' also works but 'trustworthy' is the quality.

gaps.sentence: The castle is ___ (SIGHT) for miles in every direction.
gaps.explanation: 'Be visible' = can be seen; 'visibility' is the noun for how far you can see.

gaps.sentence: Last night's ___ (PERFORM) ended with a standing ovation.
gaps.explanation: 'Last night's performance' — the noun for the event.
